The story behind the meme

A family story in Vice City.

GTA VI follows Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, two protagonists whose relationship and choices shape their path through Leonida.

Who are Jason and Lucia?

Rockstar describes Jason as a former Army serviceman now working for local drug runners in the Keys. Lucia has recently left Leonida Penitentiary and is determined to change her future. Their relationship could be the best or worst thing to happen to Jason.

Where does Tomás fit in?

A CBC launch review reports that Jason and Lucia have a newborn son named Tomás. The review says he is in the care of Lucia’s aunt while the couple hope to save enough money to build a life together with him, away from crime.

Jason DuvalFormer Army serviceman working in the Leonida Keys.
Lucia CaminosRecently released from prison and determined to change her future.
TomásHis story details are reported by CBC; Rockstar’s public character profiles do not list him.
Story details about Tomás are attributed to the CBC launch review. See Rockstar’s official Jason and Lucia profiles for confirmed character backgrounds. Spoilers ahead.
